model_unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/tripilot-arm-app-model.service
[Unit]
Description=triPilot dedicated ARM app model
After=network.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/bench/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server -m /home/ubuntu/bench/models/e4b_qat_q40.gguf -ngl 0 -t 2 -tb 2 -c 4096 -np 1 -b 128 -ub 128 --cache-ram 64 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18314 --jinja --reasoning-format deepseek --reasoning off --reasoning-budget 0
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryHigh=6G
MemoryMax=6500M
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUAccounting=yes
CPUQuota=120%
CPUWeight=200
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
